children: Market regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) on Thursday issued final framework on Closing Auction Session (CAS). SEBI has retained the 30-minute volume-weighted average price (VWAP) methodology for determining expiry-day settlement prices of index and stock derivatives, while revising the timings and operational framework of the CAS in the equity cash market. Moneycontrol had exclusively reported that SEBI's key panel on seconadary market has approved the proposal.

Under the revised framework, the CAS will operate from 3:30 pm to 3:40 pm on all trading days. The changes will take effect from December 7, 2026, except for provisions governing the transition of unexecuted limit and iceberg orders from the continuous trading session, which will come into effect on February 8, 2027.

The session will begin with a one-minute reference-price calculation and transition period from 3:30 pm to 3:31 pm. Both limit and market orders will be permitted from 3:31 pm to 3:36 pm. Thereafter, only limit orders will be allowed, while market orders cannot be modified or cancelled. The session will close randomly between 3:38 pm and 3:40 pm, followed by order matching.

The CAS reference price will be based on the VWAP of trades during the last 15 minutes of the continuous trading session. If no trade occurs during that period, the day's last traded price will apply; if the security has not traded during the day, the previous day's closing price, adjusted for corporate actions where applicable, will be used.

Trading in index derivatives will continue until 3:45 pm on normal trading days, but expiring index derivatives contracts will stop trading at 3:30 pm on expiry days. Stock derivatives will trade until 3:45 pm, including on expiry days. The cash market's post-close session will run from 3:50 pm to 4 pm, with trades executed at closing prices.
For expiry settlement, index derivatives will use the underlying index value calculated from constituent stocks' VWAPs during the last 30 minutes of the cash market's continuous trading session.
Stock derivatives will use the underlying stock's VWAP over the same period across all exchanges. Exchanges will disseminate indicative values in real time.

Market participants have welcomed the move. Uttam Bagri, Managing Director, BCB Brokerage Private Limited said, “SEBI’s decision to delink equity derivatives settlement from CAS-based price discovery removes a major irritant for market participants and is a welcome step towards smoother market functioning. Equally welcome is the restoration of cash segment trading hours to 3:30 PM, as was previously the case.”

Unexecuted limit orders will generally carry forward to the CAS, except stop-loss orders and orders outside applicable price bands. Eligible iceberg orders will transition as fully disclosed limit orders unless investors opt out when placing them. Carried-forward orders will have priority over new CAS limit orders, while converted iceberg orders will rank below other carried-forward limit orders.

New iceberg and stop-loss orders will not be permitted during CAS. Orders will generally be subject to applicable margin requirements, except eligible orders carried forward from the continuous session; modifications to such orders during CAS will trigger the requirement.
Stock futures' price bands between 3:30 pm and 3:45 pm will align with CAS price bands, without dynamic price-band flexing during that period.
SEBI has directed exchanges and clearing corporations to update their standard operating procedures within 7 days of the circular, in consultation with the regulator.

title: SEBI retains 30-minute VWAP for derivatives expiry settlement, revises closing auction timings
